svg.title: Specimen S-02: SafeCircle Guardian
svg.desc: SafeCircle Guardian: SafeCircle Guardian detects scam patterns across UPI, banking, and digital wallets by connecting evidence, reassessing risk, and reducing duplicate alerts. Built with FastAPI and Next.js, it offers explainable detection, QR checks, OCR forensics, scam-network analysis, and privacy-first safeguards.. 333 files · 71 folders · 29 commits · created 20 Oct 2026 · last push 20 Oct 2026. Languages: Python 38.8%, TypeScript 27.8%, JavaScript 23.7%, CSS 8.6%, HTML 0.9%, Dockerfile 0.1%, Mako 0.1%, Shell 0.0%.
